architecture_goal.core: Core publishes self-describing typed evidence artifacts.
architecture_goal.knowledge_layer: KLC selects evidence by artifact_kind + schema_version and owns knowledge materialization outputs.
architecture_goal.runner: Runner records execution, retries and artifact registrations without defining evidence or knowledge semantics.

allowed_runner_responsibilities: orchestrate Foundation lifecycle without defining its contents
record attempts, timeouts, resource usage and failures
invoke KLC materializations and record their manifests
compose repository, workspace and portfolio execution scopes
contract.definition: Self-describing record of analysis execution and produced typed evidence artifacts. Runner owns lifecycle, process, retry and artifact registration; Core owns evidence semantics; KLC owns knowledge materialization semantics.
forbidden_runner_responsibilities: define evidence semantics from Task, Suite, Core Profile or output path
rewrite unsupported evidence into a different schema
publish a knowledge capability merely because a Task was requested
hide analyzer or materialization failures behind fallback execution

analyzer_executions.semantic_rule: request provenance never defines artifact meaning

lifecycle.failure_rule: Missing or unsupported evidence is explicit; no hidden fallback or silent reinterpretation.
lifecycle.retry_rule: Every attempt is preserved; successful retry does not erase prior failure provenance.

materialization_executions.dispatch_rule: Runner calls only the generic KLC materialize(request, output) entrypoint.
materialization_executions.ownership_rule: Runner resolves contract-declared inputs and records execution references; KLC owns dispatch, model semantics, outputs, coverage and capabilities.

cross_contract_rules.task_profile_suite_rule: Task Suite and Core Profile are not part of canonical knowledge execution

UI implementation until backend consumers are switched

planning_conclusions.main_finding: Runner now has one canonical product runtime: knowledge_execution_plan/v1 drives Core evidence execution, generic typed-artifact registration, KLC materialization dependencies and capability publication without Task, Suite, Core Profile or knowledge-family-specific dispatch.

revised_sequence.reason: Runner resolves materialization contracts and calls one generic KLC runtime.
Runner registers arbitrary typed Core artifacts without evidence-family branches.
Knowledge Profile, actual inputs and producer catalogs compile into one validated DAG.
The product runtime executes the DAG directly and emits one canonical result.
Prove that a new evidence family requires no production-code change in Runner.
Consumers should switch only after the second evidence family proves the runtime boundary.

what_this_contract_does_not_solve: It does not create analyzer-specific evidence contracts; Core remains their owner.
It does not implement domain-specific KLC materializers; KLC remains their owner.
It does not yet switch Knowledge API, Reporting, Assistant or UI to knowledge_execution_result/v1.
It does not prove extensibility until a second independent evidence family and materializer run unchanged Runner code.

purpose: Runner-owned target execution-result contract and current runtime-manifest gap assessment.
